slides.narration: Chapter 11: The Great Carry Cascade. When adjacent positions in the tower are both occupied, the carry rule fires: eleven becomes one-zero-zero. This carry propagates upward, triggering more carries, creating a cascade that computes every physical constant.

The beauty of the cascade is that extremely simple local rules — just the carry of adjacent ones — produce extraordinarily complex global structure. The fine-structure constant, the mass ratios, the mixing angles — all emerge from carries propagating through the tower. No one programs the physics in. The carries compute it.
